format: Plain .hgt: big-endian int16, row-major, row 0 = north, n² samples, n from file length.
note: Grid sizes here are not real SRTM sizes (1201/3601) on purpose — the reader must derive n from the file length rather than assume it.

tiles.formula: same surface as N00E000 — the two share the lat = 1 boundary line
h = 1234 everywhere; southern + western hemisphere naming
h = 777 everywhere, stored gzipped to exercise the .hgt.gz path
h = max(500, 3000 − 6000·√((lat−10.5)² + (lon−-9.5)²)), with rows 8…10 × cols 8…10 written as voids (−32768)
